ctrl_bits.name: reinit_toggle
ctrl_bits.semantics: legacy pattern[0] routed to sensor reinit toggle

ctrl_bits.name: push_enable
ctrl_bits.semantics: mode enable only; extension grant still required

ctrl_bits.name: camera_ab
ctrl_bits.semantics: 0 A, 1 B; latch for whole transfer

extension_status: proposed next-backend input ONLY; not implemented, compiled, applied or hardware tested in this package

extension_registers.name: DMA_CAP_BYTES
extension_registers.semantics: u32 allocated transport capacity in bytes; only config staging; require >= frame dma_bytes

extension_registers.name: SESSION_ID
extension_registers.semantics: nonzero new session identity; staging only; reset/unload/reconnect changes session

extension_registers.name: TX_CMD
extension_registers.semantics: bit0 ARM_ONE_SHOT; bit1 ACK_RELEASE; bit2 CANCEL. Exactly one bit per write; invalid combinations rejected. ARM latches destination, capacity, doorbell, session, camera and immutable complete-source descriptor atomically; disallowed busy/held/draining. CANCEL disarms, completes any already opened TLP without success doorbell, then drains outstanding source responses before idle.

extension_registers.name: ACK_SEQ
extension_registers.semantics: staged held completion sequence, used only by ACK_RELEASE

extension_registers.name: ACK_SESSION
extension_registers.semantics: staged held session; ACK_RELEASE requires exact held seq AND session, no active DMA/drain

extension_registers.name: TX_STATUS
extension_registers.semantics: bit0 armed, bit1 busy, bit2 held, bit3 rejected/error, bit4 draining; reserved bits zero

extension_registers.name: EXT_MAGIC
extension_registers.semantics: little-endian ASCII RKA1; absent legacy read DEAD_BEEF must fail closed

extension_registers.name: EXT_VERSION
extension_registers.semantics: proposed safety interface major1 minor0; checked before any arm

default_policy: reset cap=0 session=0 armed=0. CTRL=0x61 alone MUST NOT transmit; no legacy fallback in formal mode; every accepted grant gives at most one completed frame and holds the slot until matching ACK.

host_abi.ioctl_layout_policy: existing structs and ioctl numbers unchanged; future ACK uses existing privileged BAR control path; reject incompatible EXT_MAGIC/VERSION rather than reinterpreting old bit4
